changelog: Hardening release based on vera-nodus v3.6 → v3.7 upgrade report. Zero functional changes — all fixes patch shell-specific bugs in the upgrade command that nearly corrupted the v3.7 upgrade.

FIX #2 (CRITICAL): every `cd` in the upgrade command is now wrapped in a subshell `(cd X && ...)` to prevent CWD drift across Bash tool calls. Previous form left kris-mcp landing at `.kris/kris-ui/.kris/kris-mcp/` instead of `.kris/kris-mcp/` in a silent failure mode.

FIX #1 (CRITICAL): the kris-ui download loop now uses literal inline file lists (`for f in a b c; do`) instead of shell variables (`for f in $FILES`). zsh (macOS default) does not word-split unquoted variables, which caused the v3.6 → v3.7 upgrade to fail every file on first attempt.

FIX #7: post-download integrity checks with size guards. `curl -sf` only validates HTTP 2xx — it cannot catch truncated content, empty files, or CDN misconfiguration. Every download loop now runs `wc -c` with minimum thresholds by extension and fails loudly if anything came back suspiciously small.

FIX #5: smart CLAUDE.md merge now uses `diff -b` (ignore whitespace changes) for the initial scan, with an optional full-normalization fallback. Prettier-formatted user CLAUDE.md files used to produce hundreds of lines of noise from whitespace alone.

FIX #6: explicit warning at the start of Step 2.5 that kris-mcp may be currently running. Moving `memory-bank/kris-mcp/` → `.kris/kris-mcp/` while the session is active means Claude Code must restart after the upgrade.
FIX #10: completion report box now includes an 'Expected git changes' summary, explaining that the mass deletions under memory-bank/kris-*/ are intentional (migrated to gitignored .kris/).

FIX #4 (partial): defensive Step 2.0a backfills `.kris/.upgrade-pending` if a channel argument is present but the marker is missing. Helps v3.6 → v3.7 bootstrap flows where Step 1 runs the old on-disk command that doesn't write the marker.
Channel isolation — kris-ui/ and kris-mcp/ source files now live in classic-approach/remote-templates/{stable,latest}/ so each channel can evolve independently. Root copies removed.

Tooling moved out of memory-bank/ into .kris/ — memory-bank/ is now exclusively for ring documentation. .kris/kris-ui/ and .kris/kris-mcp/ are the new homes. One-time automatic migration in /kris-upgrade handles existing v3.6 projects (moves dirs, drops + rebuilds venvs, rewrites .mcp.json command path).

wp_status returns `self: true` on the caller's particle, derived from .kris/sync.json me.id (persisted during join/create flow). Backward compatible — old sync.json without me.id falls back to no flag.
wirepulse.py /api/wp/create-circuit now returns particle_id in the response (was previously only in /api/wp/join).
Scaffolder auto-registers .mcp.json at the repo root after kris-mcp venv creation — new installs get a working MCP server without needing /kris-upgrade first.
Installer + upgrader auto-write .gitignore entries — .kris/ and .claude/commands/kris*.md are KRIS tooling, not project content. Only CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, and memory-bank/ stay committed.
Installer (kris-install.sh + .ps1) branches on VERSION — latest writes to .kris/kris-{ui,mcp}/, stable writes to memory-bank/kris-{ui,mcp}/ (v3.6 behavior preserved).
kris-ui.py gained a _discover_memory_bank() helper that walks up parents to find memory-bank/ — works from both .kris/kris-ui/ (v3.7) and memory-bank/kris-ui/ (v3.6 legacy) locations.
kris-mcp.py EXCLUDED_DIRS is now empty — kris-ui and kris-mcp no longer live under memory-bank/ so no exclusion needed.

kris-mcp — MCP server for ring operations (kris_status/list/read/write/append/search/move) and WirePulse coordination (wp_status/tasks/task_create/task_claim/task_status/messages_list/message_post/claim_file/claim_release/invite_create)
Ring tools always available; WirePulse tools load conditionally on .kris/sync.json with valid token
Writes scoped to memory-bank/ only — CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md cannot be modified via MCP

Installer (kris-install.sh + .ps1): downloads kris-mcp, auto-detects Python 3.10+ (tries python3.13 → python3.10 → python3), creates venv, installs deps, then idempotently registers in .mcp.json at the repo root with OS-aware path. Skips .mcp.json registration if venv creation fails — prevents broken Claude Code sessions.

kris-upgrade: step 2.5b (command) + section 9 (task) auto-create the kris-mcp venv if missing, update deps if present, verify `import mcp, httpx` before registering .mcp.json, and merge idempotently with existing mcpServers entries. Migrates any stale mcpServers entry from .claude/settings.json (early-v3.6 builds) to .mcp.json.

CRITICAL FIX: Claude Code reads project-scoped MCP servers from .mcp.json at the repo root — NOT from .claude/settings.json. Earlier v3.6 builds wrote to the wrong file and kris-mcp was silently unloaded. This version fixes the installer, upgrader, and templates to use the correct location.
